The per-wallet tape was captured from GMGN's 1h Smart Inflow table (Monitor > Smart / Callout at https://gmgn.ai/monitor?chain=sol&tab=smartdegen), not from token-level S-Flow aggregates. The left-rail Smart Degen mini feed was not used as the tape (it was used only to resolve full wallet addresses when a visible /sol/address/ href matched a board label by first 4 and last 4 characters). The board is a set of per-token cards, each listing up to 3 wallet rows, and it reorders every few seconds. Pass-1 cards that later scrolled out of the DOM kept their first-read rows. The board held about 15-18 cards, which limited further unique rows. All stored inflow rows have a token CA from the card href.
